mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and rising recession risk, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.0 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the signal fails to anticipate a recession in at least two of the past three recessions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for three consecutive months signals weakening demand, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the signal fails to anticipate a demand contraction in at least two of the past three episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for three consecutive months signals improving supply conditions and economic growth, which historically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the signal fails to anticipate an expansion in at least two of the past three episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 5.0% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the signal fails to anticipate a tightening-induced downturn in at least two of the past three episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) for three consecutive months signals improving labor market conditions, which historically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the signal fails to anticipate a labor market expansion in at least two of the past three episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below 2% for three consecutive months signals easing inflationary pressure, which historically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls below 2.0% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the signal fails to anticipate an inflation moderation in at least two of the past three episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4% for two consecutive months combined with a decline in payroll employment for two consecutive months signals a deteriorating labor market, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.0% and PAYEMS falls for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the signal fails to anticipate a labor market downturn in at least two of the past three episodes.
